title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
blurb: Showed that depth built from nothing but stacked 3×3 convolutions and 2×2 pooling steadily improves image classification.
intro: VGG networks are described by a single configuration list of convolution widths and pooling layers, followed by three fully connected layers. The steps cover the 3×3 convolution, the VGG block, pooling, initialisation and dropout in the classifier; the capstone builds any VGG variant from its list and counts its parameters.

steps.name: VGG block: stacked 3×3 convs, then pool
